intro: Your rule of 18 November (14-owner-calls.md call 13): nothing is withheld for missing a quality floor without your confirmation. These are the withholdings made before it, found in the app's code, settings-routes.json (a route whose condition reads "not offered" is hidden by SettingsRouteTable.offered), the stage notes and the DONE entries. Left out: your own calls in 14-owner-calls.md section 1, and anything dropped for money, licence, safety or memory. The session decisions in section 2 of that file were put to you for veto, not confirmed, so they are listed. Figures are from ArchiveProcessor/segbench-results/ unless another path is given; an interval is the paired 95% one. Routes that clearly lost to what shipped are grouped into one box per stage so they can be confirmed at once.

entries.feature: The "read poorly" flag for readers other than Apple Vision
entries.where: OCR/ReadQualityFlag.swift flags Vision readings only; the decision is in the body of 6f87dc24 (W46.post-read-quality-flag), which filed W46.post-read-flag-readers (open, behind W46.capture-warning and so behind nice-to-have).
entries.floor: At most 5% false alarms on good readings, a reading counted poor under 70 NES (post-read-flag.md).
entries.figure: Vision's own cut (0.9815) holds it: 10 of 21 poor readings caught with 3 of 75 false alarms on the 96, 179 of 231 with 7 of 249 on the capture ladder. For other readers, disagreement with Vision catches 82% of LightOnOCR's poor readings at 5% false alarms on plain photographs (cross-validated) and 33-36% of Qwen3.5 9B's, but the same cut flags 21% of Gemini's good readings of damaged images.
entries.loses: No warning at all when LightOnOCR (the free handwriting default), Gemini, Qwen or any cloud route reads a page badly.
entries.ship: The disagreement flag on LightOnOCR, labelled "measured on plain photographs"; Gemini left out or shown with its 21% false-alarm figure. Unblocking W46.post-read-flag-readers from nice-to-have.
entries.why: The one reader that clears the floor is the free default for handwriting, where a silent poor reading costs the most.

entries.feature: Readers with no row on the reading chart: Apple's on-device model, the commercial services, and fifteen dominated routes
entries.where: settings-routes.json reading rule no-apple-fm; 04-reading.md section 3 (l.76) and section 4 (l.180-219).
entries.floor: Beating, or tying at lower cost, a route already on the chart.
entries.figure: macOS 27 on-device model 42.4 against Vision's 83.1 on the 96 (-40.7, -49.0 to -32.5), 33 of 96 pages looping (r1-foundation.md). Azure 89.6, Textract 86.6, Transkribus 82.5 against Mistral 4.1's 92.5 on 25 pages (Azure -2.9, -6.3 to -0.2). Fifteen hosted and cluster routes (qwen3-vl-8b, qwen3.5-122b-a10b, glm-ocr, lightonocr3-0.8b, ppocrv6-medium and others) each below a cheaper or faster route; paddleocr-vl1.5 superseded.
entries.loses: The choice of a weaker but familiar or already-paid-for reader.
entries.ship: A "show routes that lost" setting listing them with their figures.
entries.why: Each is beaten on the same pages by something the user can pick; showing them adds choices that only do worse.

entries.feature: A post-correction stage after reading
entries.where: settings-routes.json reading rule no-post-correction; 04-reading.md l.77-80.
entries.floor: A gain over re-reading with the same model.
entries.figure: The image-grounded corrector -0.42 (-1.47 to +0.64) against re-reading with the 27B, over 57 band readings on the 96 and 120 public. Text-only correction gains 1.6 on the 96 and nothing on the public set, where it makes 47 of 120 readings worse (ocr-postcorrect.md).
entries.loses: A second pass that sometimes fixes a reading, and as often damages one.
entries.ship: An optional stage labelled "no measured gain".
entries.why: A tie at best, and text-only correction worsens two pages in five on unseen material.

entries.feature: Cascade triggers other than failure: log-probability and two-reader disagreement
entries.where: 04-reading.md l.79 and l.344; 10-kinds-and-routing.md l.50 (casc-disagree-0.5, "not built"). Owner call 5 made failure the only trigger and the Vision word-count trigger opt-in; these two were left out before that call by the session.
entries.floor: A consistent gain on unseen pages.
entries.figure: Log-probability shown only as a "check this reading" flag (ocr-logprob.md); disagreement and kind triggers "gain inconsistently on unseen pages"; the disagreement trigger "wants a larger test".
entries.loses: A second reading on pages the first reader probably got wrong but did not fail on.
entries.ship: A larger disagreement test, then an opt-in trigger beside the word-count one.
entries.why: Your call 5 already settles the cascade's design; these sit inside it and their figures do not argue for reopening it.

entries.feature: A half-size retry when a cluster reader loops
entries.where: 04-reading.md section 3 l.91; section 2 Reading ("never a half-size retry on the cluster").
entries.floor: Rescuing most looped pages.
entries.figure: Answered 351 of 1,573 looped pages on the cluster (loop-rerun-20261021.md); on the Mac it led on three MLX loops (87.5), n 3.
entries.loses: A cheap rescue for the fifth of looped pages it answers.
entries.ship: A retry step before the second-reader fallback, labelled with its 22% rescue rate.
entries.why: The second VLM reader that is used instead rescues more; a 22% step in front of it adds time to every loop.

entries.feature: Cleaning the image before reading (shading, GCDRNet, SBB, DocRes, colour dropout, crop as OCR input)
entries.where: 02-ocr-input.md sections 2-3 (l.11-61), ocr-colour-dropout.md; 01-reading-copy.md l.20 (crop); section 2 OCR input. Owner call 6 covers only the reading copy.
entries.floor: The paired interval clearing 0 and a 0.49 NES gap (02-ocr-input.md l.25).
entries.figure: Five methods on 63 originals and the 96: none gained, several lost (Vision with SBB -6.4, -8.8 to -4.2; Gemini with shading -0.8, -1.6 to -0.2). Colour dropout on 40 pages: Vision +0.7 (-1.3 to +3.1), Gemini 3.7 -7.2 (-12.6 to -2.7); on the 16 pages with a real coloured mark Vision +3.4 (-0.1 to +8.4), but no cue picks those pages out. Crop on the originals -0.3 (-1.5 to +1.4). The Qwen3-VL 8B null is underpowered (about 5 NES).
entries.loses: An optional "clean before reading" setting; perhaps a small gain for Vision on stamped pages.
entries.ship: A per-route opt-in labelled with its measured change.
entries.why: No method gains on any reader measured, and the stamp lead cannot be aimed at the pages it helps.

entries.feature: DocRes cleaning on glare pages
entries.where: 02-ocr-input.md section 6 l.79, held as a lead inside the no-enhancement rule.
entries.floor: A result, not a lead: more than 6 pages, a significant pair.
entries.figure: On 6 glare pages, Vision with DocRes appearance +10.2 (+0.6 to +25.6), deshadow +9.2 (+0.2 to +24.8); p 0.129 across the set.
entries.loses: A possible rescue of glare pages, which cost handwriting the most (27B -12.9, Gemini -16.1 on 8 pages).
entries.ship: A test on more glare pages; then a setting triggered by a glare tag. DocRes needs a cluster GPU, so it would be a cluster setting.
entries.why: The largest gain in the OCR-input work, on too few pages to offer; a bigger test is cheap and offline.

entries.feature: Rotation without Apple Vision: Tesseract, small local VLMs, PP-LCNet alone on right-to-left pages
entries.where: 01-reading-copy.md section 3 l.18 ("must not run").
entries.floor: Vision and the agreement rule (3 of 119 held-out pages wrong).
entries.figure: Tesseract OSD 62.7%, Qwen3-VL 8B 78.1% over all turns (rotation-routes.md); PP-LCNet alone flips 73 of 80 Hebrew turns.
entries.loses: A rotation route on a machine without Vision.
entries.ship: Rows labelled "below Vision".
entries.why: Every user of the app has Vision; these turn pages wrong a third of the time or more.

entries.feature: Layout regions off newspapers: other kinds, handwriting, registers; Vision on regions; Apple's document request
entries.where: 03-layout.md section 2 l.15-18 and section 3 l.31 (calls 2-3, section 2 Layout); settings-routes.json layout-never-hands-registers; VisionOCRKit Prefs.swift figures() returns nil for Vision on regions off newspapers.
entries.floor: Beating the whole page.
entries.figure: On the 96, whole page 90.9 against heron 87.1 (-3.9, -7.7 to -0.3); tables with PP -9.1 (-18.3 to -2.3). On 16 hand pages 70.5 against 85.8 (-15.3, -28.2 to -4.4); on L4's 80 registers -10.8 (-14.8 to -6.8) (layout-photo-tables.md). Vision on regions off newspapers: 1.20% to 1.09% wrong at twice the time, no interval. Apple's document request 16.8 NES on L9.
entries.loses: A region pass that, where measured, loses text, apart from Vision's 0.1-point gain at twice the time.
entries.ship: A "read by regions" setting per kind, labelled with these losses.
entries.why: The losses are measured and large on handwriting and registers; Vision's one gain is a tenth of a point for double the time.

entries.feature: DocLayout-YOLO as the detector for scanned newspapers
entries.where: 03-layout.md l.25 and call 1 (section 2 Layout picked PP-DocLayoutV3 for every newspaper).
entries.floor: Working on photographed newspapers.
entries.figure: On photographs it loses 40.1 on Skew and keeps no region on 58 of 155 pages; on the 15 L9 scans it leads PP-DocLayoutV3 by 4.6 (1.1 to 8.0), descriptive (layout-pair-newspapers.md).
entries.loses: About 5 points on flatbed-scanned newspapers.
entries.ship: A detector setting "scanned newspapers", labelled measured on 15 scans.
entries.why: It fails on photographs, which is why it is not the default, but users with scans (common outside your corpus) lose a measured gain.

entries.feature: Whole-page reading of newspapers for large readers (the detector is always run)
entries.where: 03-layout.md call 5 (l.105, l.124); section 2 Layout ("the gain is nil, not negative").
entries.floor: The reverse case: the detector is kept although it does not help.
entries.figure: 27B whole page 0.967 against regions 0.965 on 15 pages.
entries.loses: The time of a detector pass that adds nothing for large readers.
entries.ship: A "read whole" choice for large readers on newspapers, or letting the solver's "faster wins on a tie" rule pick it.
entries.why: A tie on 15 pages; your tie rule says the faster arrangement wins.

entries.feature: Other line layers: Orli base lines, Vision's document-request lines, block-emitting readers
entries.where: settings-routes.json placement hand-orli-ctc ("not offered; kept as a measured alternative"); 05-placement.md l.90, l.110-125.
entries.floor: Beating the shipped placer.
entries.figure: Orli lines 38.3% line pass (182 of 475), -4.6 (-14.9 to +4.2), a tie (place-hands-lines.md). Vision document-request lines -10.8 (-15.3 to -6.5) (place-print.md). Unlimited-OCR and Nemotron-Parse 2.0 keep 9.4-13.5% of truth lines whole.
entries.loses: Little: alternatives to a placer that does as well or better.
entries.ship: An option in the cluster placement setting.
entries.why: A tie and two clear losses.

entries.feature: A stamps and signatures layer
entries.where: 06-marks.md sections 2-3 ("not offered yet"); section 2 Marks. You put the two-pass route (W46.marks-detect-own) behind nice-to-have on 6 November; that the layer is not offered at all was the session's.
entries.floor: Detecting most marks.
entries.figure: Best detector YOLO11m: 8 of 45 marks at 0.25 (18%, 5-37%), 17 of 45 at 0.05 (38%, 21-60%), precision 42-53% (marks-detect.md). A whole page plus a YOLO box adds 0-3 marks per reader, p 0.5 or more.
entries.loses: A list of stamps and signatures on each page.
entries.ship: A layer labelled "finds about 1 mark in 5".
entries.why: At one mark in five with half its finds wrong, the layer would mislead more than help; your nice-to-have item is the route to a better detector.

entries.feature: The magazine kind "ranks nothing yet" for routes without the article rule
entries.where: 07-segmentation.md section 3 rule (a) l.67-78, call 5; settings-routes.json rule magazine-article-rule (5945c0b8).
entries.floor: A valid comparison: the students trained on the box and the older prompts lack the article rule.
entries.figure: Gemini 3.8 with g2 now ranks (93.8% of gaps against g1's 71.2%, seg-magazine-rule.md); g1, w1, c1 and the students still show figures without being picked.
entries.loses: A pick among the older prompts and the students on magazines.
entries.ship: W46.seg-magazine-rule-redo, already filed.
entries.why: A validity gap rather than a missed level, already partly lifted; the redo item settles the rest.

entries.feature: Segmentation options that did not help: the document-split and feature models, few-shot examples, self-voting, a collection-facts block, letter cue c2, disagreement review on every route
entries.where: 07-segmentation.md section 2 l.15, l.87-88, l.275, SEG-4 l.290, call 3 option (b); section 2 Segmentation.
entries.floor: A measured gain over the shipped prompt.
entries.figure: Split and feature models 29.1% unchecked with 86.8 checks per 100 pages against manual's 86.8 (seg-adapt-curve.md). Few-shot: no measurable gain at 1.43-2.01 times the input tokens (seg-adapt-fewshot.md). Self-voting and the facts block from seg-window-modality.md and seg-context.md, c2 no measured effect. Review on every route doubles the cost while the models err alike.
entries.loses: Settings that cost more and do not change the result.
entries.ship: Each as an opt-in labelled "no measured gain".
entries.why: None changes the result, and most add cost.

entries.feature: The Mac Qwen3-VL 8B image pass on the no-key laptop dating route
entries.where: settings-routes.json dating qwen3-vl-8b-image-mac (a7068d5f, local baseline 57ddaeee); 08-dating.md call 7.5, "decided as recommended (section 2)", not one of your section-1 calls as pass 16 said.
entries.floor: "Once its quotes improve the year" over the text-only route.
entries.figure: On 55 documents with no year in their Vision text: strict reading gains 0 and loses 1; as a quote source gains 1 and loses 2 (sign test p 1.0); 32 of 55 right either way (58.2%, 45-70); false years on undated documents 20 to 21 of 90 (date-8b-local.md). On the traces it gains 0 (date-route-pipeline.md).
entries.loses: The only page-image dating a 16 GB Mac with no key could have.
entries.ship: An optional switch, off, labelled "no measured gain".
entries.why: No gain on either measure, and it costs a model download and its time.

entries.feature: Dating options below the baseline: trained 2B and 4B as defaults, typeface and paper dating, look-alike retrieval, an enclosure step, entity links
entries.where: 08-dating.md 7.4 (l.403-406), step 5 (l.81-83, DAT-4), step 3a (l.36-39, DAT-5), 09-entities.md l.367-369; section 2 Dating; settings-routes.json no-typeface-dating.
entries.floor: The shipped route's figure, or the simple baseline.
entries.figure: Trained 2B and 4B 38.9% (51 of 131) on years not in the text, against the shipped route's 47.3%; 0 of 50 owner-uncertain documents marked uncertain (date-model.md); the 2B stays as the chooser. Typeface ranges hold the year on 11 of 12 at a median width of 50 years (date-image-typeface.md). Retrieval 27 of 122 exact against 52 for the nearest dated document before (date-image.md). Enclosure: 0 of 3 owner enclosures found on every arm but the 27B (1 of 3) (date-enclosure.md). Entity links bracket 2 of 54 documents.
entries.loses: A coarse range for undated documents (typeface) and "Sent With" dating beyond the near-inert marker.
entries.ship: Each as a labelled option ("range, about 50 years"; "found 1 of 3").
entries.why: Each does worse than what ships or than the simple baseline; the trained models also cite no evidence, which your traceable rule needs.

entries.feature: The 8,000-character Gemini entity prompt
entries.where: 09-entities.md l.133-149 and section 9 l.382-383; settings-routes.json gemini-entity8k.
entries.floor: A gain over the shipped call; withheld because its 3,000-character twin ties the shipped call, and it was never paired with the shipped call itself.
entries.figure: Sender 0.76 against 0.69, place 0.84 against 0.80; the one paired figure for prompt length is +0.087 (+0.022 to +0.170) on sender, on the built truth (ent-score-paid.md). Cost about $3.0 per 1,000 documents, an estimate (88 of 138 calls cached).
entries.loses: Probably better senders and places on cloud routes.
entries.ship: A paired run against the shipped call on the cached owner truth, then the prompt as the default if it holds.
entries.why: The paired evidence points toward the longer prompt, not away; one paired run settles it.

entries.feature: Names on Macs too small for the 8B (NLTagger, GLiNER2.5), and on pre-modern hands and early print
entries.where: settings-routes.json entities nltagger ("never offered… kept as the measured floor"), gliner2.5-base-spans-rule; 09-entities.md section 3 kind rule (e) l.42.
entries.floor: The 8B extractor's level; no floor is written for kind rule (e).
entries.figure: Sender F1 0.14 (NLTagger) and 0.24 (GLiNER) on 138 owner documents; even a perfect position rule reaches at most 35 and 60 of 138 named senders (ent-truth-owner.md, ent-score.md). Pre-modern Latin hands and early print 0.02-0.37 on L5 and L7 (ent-robust.md).
entries.loses: Any names on an 8 GB Mac with no key, and on medieval and early-modern material.
entries.ship: A row labelled "low confidence".
entries.why: At these levels most names written would be wrong; a cloud route covers both cases.

entries.feature: Routing by kind on pages under the classifier's 0.8 confidence floor
entries.where: settings-routes.json kinds rule low-confidence-keeps-model; 10-kinds-and-routing.md section 3 l.38-43; section 2 Kinds. The 0.8 comes from K-kinds section 5 (W41.app-page-kind); no measurement behind it was found.
entries.floor: 0.8 on the top class.
entries.figure: 78 of 848 pages fall under it, 16 of them among the 28 pages whose hand differs from the rest of their document (kind-churn.md). Routing by true kind reads 97.26 against 96.47 for the best single reader on the 96 (kind-classifier.md section 4).
entries.loses: Kind routing on about one page in eleven, including most of the odd-hand pages it would help.
entries.ship: Route on the top class with an "unsure" mark, or the document prior (filed, not measured); a measurement of the cut itself.
entries.why: The floor itself is unmeasured; measure the document prior and the cut before choosing.

entries.feature: A mixed-page pre-flag (ATRIUM or another), so the mixed switch acts only on flagged pages
entries.where: settings-routes.json kinds atrium-zero-shot ("not offered while the shipped classifier is kept"); 10-kinds-and-routing.md P4-1 l.86-88, l.61, section 6 l.113. Your call 3 set the switch off for its time cost; that is not this.
entries.floor: Beating the shipped classifier on kinds, and an established filter for mixed pages.
entries.figure: As a kind classifier ATRIUM is worse: 121 of 141 against 137 (p 0.000855), 638 of 895 against 723 (kind-atrium.md). On mixed pages it is far ahead: recall 51-60% at 69.8% precision against the shipped classifier's 12-14%. The pre-flag guessed the band on 7 of 14 pages (mixed-route-bands.md). Without a pre-flag the switch costs about 140 times Vision's time on every typed page (ocr-time-like-for-like.md, the like-for-like timing call 3 waited for).
entries.loses: A mixed switch cheap enough to turn on.
entries.ship: ATRIUM as an optional download used only as the mixed pre-flag, labelled with its recall and precision; then re-asking call 3 with the timing in hand.
entries.why: Its licence is no longer a bar since 17 November, and as a pre-flag it is four times the shipped classifier's recall.

entries.feature: A sharpness or retake warning on the phone, and Gemini's quality score as a retake check
entries.where: settings-routes.json capture rule cap-guidance ("no tilt or compression warning"); 11-capture.md sections 3, 5, 7, 8 call 1; section 2 Capture. W46.capture-warning is open behind nice-to-have; your note of 17 November said a non-live warning is still worthwhile.
entries.floor: A cut chosen on held-out real captures (11-capture.md section 7).
entries.figure: In-sample cuts catch 48-69% of losses with 17-34% false alarms on good pages; the Vision cut about 28% false alarms; Laplacian AUC 0.70-0.75 (capture-ladder.md). Gemini's score AUC 0.81-0.90 pooled, below a page-blind 0.83-0.91, and 0.50-0.80 within one defect, on 480 images of 48 pages.
entries.loses: A one-tap retake prompt on a blurred capture; the app shows static guidance.
entries.ship: A warning at the Vision cut labelled "in-sample, about 28% false alarms", or W46.capture-warning brought forward from nice-to-have.
entries.why: Your 17 November note already wants the non-live warning; bringing W46.capture-warning forward also unblocks the reader flag above.

entries.feature: Trained segmentation models for small materials (the kit gate's minimums)
entries.where: 12-training-kit.md section 3 l.49-62, calls 7.2 and 7.5; section 2 Kit.
entries.floor: Session-set: the paired interval's low end above -3 points, at least 267 known gaps and 10 held-out documents, two scored runs, a 3.2-point anchor margin.
entries.figure: The measured continuation's own next box, Lincoln box 2, holds 244 gaps and so fails the 267 minimum, though its errors fell from 17.2 to 4.9 per 100 gaps (-12.3, -18.8 to -7.4) (seg-kit-gate.md, seg-adapt-lora.md).
entries.loses: Any trained model for a material with under 267 known gaps or 10 documents: bound volumes and registers, which the note names.
entries.ship: Admit a model under the minimum with a "small held-out set" label and its interval shown.
entries.why: The one measured case would be refused despite a large, clear gain; a label tells the user how thin the check is.

entries.feature: Item fields off the remote gateway, and three fields off their measured kinds
entries.where: ItemFieldPolicy.skipReason (Tagging/ItemFieldExtractor.swift:269-273): not run on a Local Agent plan or a local-model gateway. ItemFieldPolicy.withheld (l.250-265): byline and publication date only on published kinds, recipient place only on correspondence, "not measured on this kind". Title fills everywhere since your gate (6d1fb653).
entries.floor: The fill rule: Wilson lower bound 0.85 and point 0.90 on owner-checked pairs (FieldStatus.swift, item-fields-score.md).
entries.figure: Only the Gemini 3.7 image prompt fills (0.91, 0.86-0.94 stratified, of 147). GPT 5.6 Luna 0.82 (0.76-0.87), below the bar. The local Qwen 27B, 8B and 4B rows are "too close" or below the bar, but were scored on ABBYY text, which your 30 October rule bars, so no local route has a valid figure.
entries.loses: Every item field on the Mac and on a Local Agent plan, and three fields on kinds nobody measured.
entries.ship: A local route scored on Vision text or the page images; then fill under a "lower confidence" status, which the Reader already shows for dates and containers.
entries.why: This is mostly a missing measurement rather than a miss; rescoring the local rows on Vision text is offline and $0.

excluded: Your section-1 calls: dewarping and shading division not offered (call 6), the handwriting fine-tune dropped (call 7), hand pages flagged "needs a download or a key" (call 4), the mixed switch off (call 3), the hand layer only at 0.9 alignment and every hand page given a text page (call 12, which also covers why free-profile LightOnOCR hand text is not placed on the image), the failure-only cascade (call 5), the 4B entity extractor not offered and no sender from Vision text (call 11 and the 13 November walkthrough; section 2 repeats the 4B as vetoable, so the two sections disagree on whose it is), gemini-tagging-place (call 10), the rerun floor not deciding a pick (call 14).

A non-explicit date estimate that fails the evidence check is not shown (call 9) "until item 8.3 fixes the checker's false refusals". 8.3 (W46.date-evidence-check) shipped on 11 November, so the condition may now be met; worth a look, but it is your call, not this list's.
Dropped for money: the image pass only where the text gives no year, and no month or day image pass (about $0.51 per 1,000); the qwen3.5-27b reading rerun waits on the paid hold.
Dropped for memory: the Mac segmentation LoRA, the PP-OCRv6 hand detector on the Mac (32 GB).
Dropped for safety: crop and dewarp on the reading copy, under your no-removal rule.

Never measured, so withheld for want of a figure rather than a miss: direct-key rotation, the ChatGPT plan's OCR row, 27B readers on 32 and 64 GB Macs, Vision on non-Latin scripts, LightOnOCR off handwriting, names on non-correspondence and on a Local Agent plan, the 2B on 8 GB Macs, the right-to-left placement path, a handwritten-date reader.
No working signal, so nothing to ship: a glare warning (AUC 0.52-0.53 at best), a low-resolution flag, a trained reading-order model (Vision's order 0.972 ties the column sort's 0.971).
Lifted since: the text-only segmentation tier (your pick, 13 November); the title field (6d1fb653); the OpenRouter listing (W41.app-openrouter-unmeasured).
Routes hidden by provider terms (15-training-terms.md) are a privacy rule, not a quality floor.
